title: Neighbors: Suburban Warfare
provenance: Reported by Naavalanarul (upstream#307, 2026-10-04), Apple M4 Max, macOS 27.0, KLYC-Box 0.10.2, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r17, DXMT as the environment's mode, recipes steam and vcrun2022, rated 5 of 5 after 13 minutes. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: An online player-versus-player game, Direct3D 11 by its store page. Reported perfect on DXMT on the default engine r17 on an M4 Max after a 13-minute session. The anti-cheat map has no entry for it, and Steam's public launch entry starts the game directly, a protected launch through start_protected_game.exe (Easy Anti-Cheat's launcher) exists only on the developer branches of its Steam configuration, read from that configuration rather than measured here. Whether the reporter played a full online match was not said, no frame rate was given and nothing was measured here.
